source: CHANGELOG.md 0.1.0 to 0.17.0 and docs/design.md sections 10 to 18

items.label: One jobserver for every build
items.detail: slot serve owns one GNU-make jobserver FIFO; cargo, rustc and GNU make in every job draw from it.

items.label: Queue by priority, then arrival
items.detail: A job waits until the slots it needs are free; jobs are admitted by level (urgent, high, normal, low), in the order they arrived inside a level (0.17.0).

items.label: Cancel a job
items.detail: slot cancel <id> ends a queued or running job of your own; Ctrl-C, SIGTERM or SIGHUP to the client does the same (0.5.1).

items.label: Waits for disk and memory
items.detail: A job queues while its filesystem has under 25 GB free or available memory is below its expected peak (0.5.0).

items.label: Frees disk from old target directories
items.detail: Under 40 GB free, the least recently built Cargo target directories that jobs used are deleted until 50 GB are free; the first release only reports what it would delete (0.15.0).

items.label: Upgrade a busy daemon
items.detail: systemctl --user reload slot re-executes at once and hands every running and queued job to the new binary (0.11.0).

items.label: Lost slots come back
items.detail: Tokens a killed compiler took with it are written back while jobs wait and no other process has the jobserver open (0.12.0).

items.label: Job priority
items.detail: slot --priority <level> or SLOT_PRIORITY sets a job's level; slot priority set <repo> <level> keeps rules per repository; a job queued 30 minutes counts as high; an urgent job may borrow slots the headroom holds back (0.17.0).

items.label: Share of the pool
items.detail: slot usage and the web view sum slot time, CPU time, jobs and queue wait per project, repository or session over a window (0.17.0).

items.label: A job names its slots
items.detail: slot --tokens N or SLOT_TOKENS=N holds N slots for a job, for a script that starts a container with --cpus N (0.16.0).

items.label: rust, go, node-test, ignite and other
items.detail: cargo is a jobserver client, go holds a fixed share and runs with -p set to it, ignite test holds one slot per test job (0.13.0), anything else holds one slot and passes the pool down.

items.label: Headroom
items.detail: slot headroom N or the web UI slider keeps N % of the CPU out of builds, by slots and by a systemd CPU quota (0.3.0).

items.label: Headroom of the machine
items.detail: slot headroom --base machine: the pool's CPU quota is lowered by the load measured outside it, down to 2 CPUs, so the whole machine stays under the target; status and the web view name the top cgroups outside (0.16.0).

items.label: Call mode
items.detail: While a call uses the microphone or camera, the headroom goes up to the call value and back 2 minutes after (0.5.0).

items.label: Web UI
items.detail: Timeline, slot usage, cores per toolchain, active and finished jobs, live output on 127.0.0.1:7411.

items.label: Job log
items.detail: One JSON line per finished job: command, toolchain, slots held, queue wait, run time, CPU seconds, peak memory, exit code.

items.label: sccache watchdog
items.detail: The daemon refills an sccache server jobserver that has leaked its tokens (0.5.0).

items.label: Remote build server
items.detail: SLOT_HOST syncs the repository with rsync and runs the build through slot proxy over ssh; target directories stay on the server.

items.label: Fetch artifacts back
items.detail: slot --fetch PATH copies named build outputs from the server into the checkout after the job exits 0 (0.8.0).

items.label: Target directory seeding and eviction
items.detail: A new worktree starts from a reflink copy of the same repository's latest target directory; least recently used ones are deleted over --cache-budget or the disk floor (0.9.0).

items.label: Restricted ssh command
items.detail: slot shell, an authorized_keys forced command that runs only the sync, fetch, proxy and cancel steps (0.10.0).

items.label: Per-repository configuration
items.detail: .slot.toml lists command prefixes that run on the local daemon while SLOT_HOST sends the rest to the server (0.7.0).

items.label: Claude Code plugin
items.detail: A PreToolUse hook refuses builds outside the pool; the slot-warden agent lists sessions that bypass it (0.4.0).
